tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// shog dril bzhi'i brgyud rim gsol 'debs bzhugs so//

yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang*// grub pa'i mchog brnyes rje btsun shes rab bzang*// mkhas mchog dam pa ye shes dngos grub zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gnas lugs don gzigs mnga' bdag mai tri pa// skad gnyis smra ba chos kyi blo gros zhabs// lam zab ston mdzad mtshur ston dbang gi mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa'i gnyag sgom zhes// don gnyis mthar phyin 'gro mgon dge chung pa// yongs kyi bshes gnyen dwags po mdung rtse pa// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'gro ba'i lam ston nyi ma lung pa dang*// mchog gi 'bras bu brnyes pa mgar yas mtshan// 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig tog rtse sgang pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mkhas pa'i dbang po snye mdo thams cad mkhyen// brtse ldan snye mdo kun dga' dngos grub dang*// mtshan ldan g.yung ston chen po rdo rje dpal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'khor lo gnyis ldan bsod nams bzang po zhes// bag yod tshul ldan tshul khrims mgon po dang*/ */ 'gro la bu ltar brtse ba'i bsod rgyal ba// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// yongs kyi 'dren mchog rin chen gso skong ba// 'dul mngon mthar phyin mkhan chen seṅge dpal// rngog rigs las byung dam pa byang chub dpal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol| |thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs// mkhas shing grub pa mthar phyin dbang phyug dpal// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// nā ro'i rnam 'phrul mi pham padma dkar// mkhas grub ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po dang*// grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' lhun grub zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// steng sgo rnam grol gnad dang 'khrul 'khor bcu// 'og sgo bde chen mkhas pa sprug pa bcu// zung 'jug rtsa rlung las rung sbyor ba yi// bde stong lhan skyes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// chu bur dang 'dra'i lus 'di 'jig pa'i tshe// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'chi ltas mthong ma thag

/rlung sems yi ge'i sbyor bas mtshams sbyar nas// 'pho ba mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// lus sems bral ba'i skad cig rim can gyis// bar do'i snang ba rim gyis 'char ba'i tshe// sgom stobs bag chags dran pa'i so zin te// 'khrul snang chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa| |rang sems chos sku'i rol par ngo shes nas// gshis sam babs kyi phyag rgya chen po'i sku// rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par byin gyis rlobs// skye ba kun tu sogs brjod/ de ltar shog dril bzhi'i brgyud rim gsol 'debs 'di'ang rje btsun mar pa'i bsnyen dril yid bzhin nor bu'i cha lag tu/ 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i gdung gi tha shal rang gshis rang ngo 'phrod pa'i gnas lugs mngon du byas pa/ shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ gzhu spro lung gi gzim chung dbang ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
